description:
A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.

A Flutter LLM Chat Client. Support Android & iOS & Harmony Next.
✨ Features
- 🎨 Modern Design - Material You design language with dynamic color theming support (Android 12+).
- 🌙 Dark Mode - Perfectly adapted dark theme to protect your eyes.
- 🌍 Multi-language Support - Supports both English and Chinese interfaces.
- 🖥️ Multi-platform Support - Mobile (Android/iOS/Harmony) and Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux).
- 🔄 Multi-provider Support - Supports major AI providers like OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, etc.
- 🤖 Custom Assistants - Create and manage personalized AI assistants.
- 🖼️ Multimodal Input - Supports various formats including images, text documents, PDFs, Word documents, etc.
- 📝 Markdown Rendering - Full support for code highlighting, LaTeX formulas, tables, and more.
- 🎙️ Voice/TTS Providers - Built-in system TTS plus OpenAI / Google Gemini / ElevenLabs voice servers.
- 🛠️ MCP Support - Model Context Protocol tool integration.
- 🧰 Built-in MCP Tools - Includes a built-in MCP Fetch tool.
- 🔍 Web Search - Integrated with multiple search engines (Exa, Tavily, Zhipu, LinkUp, Brave, Bing, Metaso, SearXNG, Ollama, Jina, Perplexity, Bocha).
- 🧩 Prompt Variables - Supports dynamic variables like model name, time, etc.
- 📤 QR Code Sharing - Export and import provider configurations via QR codes.
- 💾 Data Backup - Supports chat history backup and restoration.
- 🌐 Custom Requests - Supports custom HTTP request headers and bodies.
- 🔡 Custom Fonts - Bring your own fonts (system fonts / Google Fonts).
- ⚙️ Android Background Generation - Keep chat generation running in the background (optional setting).
What's Changed
- feat: Rebuild Markdown rendering, with GitHub alerts, directive cards, inline HTML, themed highlights, math, and bounded SVG.
- feat: Copy a message as Markdown, and copy a selection as rich HTML.
- feat: Add an integrated browser with tabs, bookmarks, history, downloads, and agent browser tools. Browser steps appear as page cards on the timeline, with workspace page previews.
- feat: Add IntelligentUI, including layouts, forms, charts, tables, and restricted web previews, with a built-in visualize skill.
- feat: Add reversible context management. Compress a chat into an editable summary or mark a context boundary, then undo either one. Original messages are kept.
- feat: Add per-conversation tool permissions, with ask-for-approval and full access.
- feat: Add grouped MCP server management and a unified tools panel.
- feat: Add optional password encryption for backups.
- feat: Add a custom data directory on Windows.
- feat: Copy world book entries, and move them between books in a batch.
- feat: Add an optional native text selection menu on iOS 26 and later.
- feat: Add DeepSeek web search and full-page fetch, including publication dates.
- feat: Add Groq and Mistral speech transcription.
- feat: Choose memory types that are always injected in full, ignoring the per-type item limit.
- feat: Add Gemini 4 support, including thinking levels and thought-signature replay.
- fix: Replay Gemini tool calls one round at a time, keep each round's text and thinking, and keep code-execution IDs unique.
- fix: Correct Claude adaptive thinking modes and model defaults, and leave synthetic citation cards out of history.
- fix: Keep Responses tool history in order, retain tool images, and merge reasoning fragments before replay.
- fix: Send MCP tool images when a turn continues or history is replayed.
- fix: Keep assistant identities and their chats attached after an upgrade.
- fix: Refresh the Codex model list after the app version changes.
- fix: Preserve Android IME edits in long messages, including select all, cut, and composition.
- fix: Stop Windows from attaching the same image twice on a newly sent message.
- fix: Keep long-image exports at full precision, and speed up their previews.
- fix: Keep data when an import or migration fails, recover a missing installation, and resume a Windows restore blocked by a locked folder.
- fix: Leave iOS app data out of system backups.
- fix: Keep the desktop composer focused when switching windows, and restore title-bar double-click zoom on macOS.
- fix: Follow the bottom of a streaming reply directly, instead of delayed auto-scroll.
- fix: Run the sandbox on 32-bit Android, and pass the app proxy into guest processes.
- fix: Keep calculator results exact, correct GPT-5 reasoning defaults, and enable reasoning for OpenRouter Auto.
- fix: Normalize Qwen WAV audio before playback.
- fix: Sign and notarize macOS release builds.
- fix: Speed up search, long histories, avatar loading, and reasoning-slider dragging.
- fix: Fix several other known bugs and UI issues.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Chevey339/kelivo/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2
